intended_use: methodological internal benchmark of prespecified classifier configurations; not clinical deployment
target_population: eligible adult respondents in the 2025 BRFSS public-use aggregate with DIABETE4 in {1,3}
outcome_definition: self-reported diagnosed diabetes status: DIABETE4=1 vs DIABETE4=3
development_cohort: BRFSS 2025 public-use aggregate; random 80% development partition
evaluation_cohort: same-source random 20% held-out internal test partition
predictor_availability_rule: survey variables observed contemporaneously with outcome; diabetes-specific diagnosis/treatment fields excluded
missing_data_strategy: BRFSS sentinel recoding; categorical explicit missing category; numeric training-only median imputation
hyperparameter_tuning: none; seven prespecified fixed baseline configurations
internal_validation: stratified 5-fold CV in development data plus held-out internal test
clinical_utility: not assessed; no clinical decision threshold or utility claim

survey_design.estimand_justification: unweighted predictive performance in the analyzed respondent sample; population inference is out of scope

notes: Historical artifact key pr_auc denotes sklearn Average Precision (AP).
No equivalence claim is made from non-significant paired contrasts.
External/temporal and subgroup validation are required before deployment claims.
